## Samsung Claims 39.4% DRAM Share and 22% Smartphone Share in Reported Period

If the 39.4% DRAM share figure is verified, it would indicate Samsung reclaiming ground from SK Hynix — with direct implications for memory pricing dynamics and HBM competitive balance. The concurrent handset share gain adds breadth to the recovery thesis and is relevant to Apple's supply chain and component pricing.

- Samsung has lifted its DRAM market share to 39.4%, per Chosunbiz data cited in the headline.
- Smartphone market share has risen to 22%, with gains recorded across both memory and handsets simultaneously.
- Dual share gains across two major segments suggest a broad-based competitive recovery.
- No time period for the share figures is specified in the headline.
